description: This file defines the LLMSwitcher class, which manages switching between multiple LLM services at runtime using different strategies, allowing inference execution and function registration on multiple LLMs within a pipeline.

classes.name: LLMSwitcher
classes.description: A pipeline component that manages switching between multiple LLMs at runtime, providing inference execution and function registration capabilities.

methods.name: __init__(self, llms: List[LLMService], strategy_type: Type[StrategyType])
methods.description: Initializes the LLMSwitcher with a list of LLM services and a switching strategy.

methods.name: List[LLMService] llms(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of LLM services managed by this switcher.

methods.name: Optional[LLMService] active_llm(self)
methods.description: Returns the currently active LLM service, or None if no LLM is active.

methods.name: Optional[str] run_inference(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Performs inference using the currently active LLM with the provided context, returning the response string or None.

methods.name: register_function( self, function_name: Optional[str], handler: Any, start_callback=None, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a handler for LLM function calls to all managed LLMs, with optional callback and interruption behavior.

methods.name: register_direct_function( self, handler: DirectFunction, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a direct function handler for all managed LLMs, supporting direct function registration.

ctags.name: register_direct_function
ctags.signature: ( self, handler: DirectFunction, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )

ctags.name: register_function
ctags.signature: ( self, function_name: Optional[str], handler: Any, start_callback=None, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )

ctags.name: run_inference
ctags.pattern: /^    async def run_inference(self, context: LLMContext) -> Optional[str]:$/
